name: 32 - API - List Human Handoff Queue - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS status_filter,
        $3::TEXT AS priority_filter,
        $4::TEXT AS task_type_filter,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS assigned_to,
        $6::BOOLEAN AS overdue_only,
        LEAST(GREATEST($7::INTEGER, 1), 500) AS result_limit
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,
        request.status_filter,
        request.priority_filter,
        request.task_type_filter,
        request.assigned_to,
        request.overdue_only,
        request.result_limit

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY clinic.id
    LIMIT 1
),

filtered_tasks AS (
    SELECT
        task.id AS handoff_task_id,
        task.task_type,
        task.source_type,
        task.source_record_id,
        task.priority,
        task.status AS task_status,
        task.reason,
        task.due_at,
        task.assigned_to,
        task.attempt_count,
        task.last_attempt_at,
        task.last_contact_channel,
        task.last_contact_outcome,
        task.resolution_code,
        task.resolution_note,
        task.created_at,
        task.updated_at,
        task.resolved_at,

        clinic.clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        appointment.id AS appointment_id,
        appointment.starts_at,
        appointment.ends_at,
        appointment.status AS appointment_status,
        appointment.google_calendar_event_id,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
        service.name AS service_name,

        CASE
            WHEN task.due_at IS NOT NULL
             AND task.due_at < NOW()
             AND task.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_overdue,

        CASE task.priority
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1
            WHEN 'high' THEN 2
            WHEN 'normal' THEN 3
            WHEN 'low' THEN 4
            ELSE 5
        END AS priority_rank

    FROM human_handoff_tasks task

    INNER JOIN clinic_context clinic
        ON clinic.clinic_id = task.clinic_id

    LEFT JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = task.patient_id

    LEFT JOIN appointments appointment
        ON appointment.id = task.appointment_id

    LEFT JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = appointment.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = appointment.service_id

    WHERE (
        clinic.status_filter = 'all'

        OR (
            clinic.status_filter = 'active'
            AND task.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
        )

        OR task.status = clinic.status_filter
    )

      AND (
        clinic.priority_filter = 'all'
        OR task.priority = clinic.priority_filter
      )

      AND (
        clinic.task_type_filter = 'all'
        OR task.task_type = clinic.task_type_filter
      )

      AND (
        clinic.assigned_to IS NULL
        OR task.assigned_to = clinic.assigned_to
      )

      AND (
        clinic.overdue_only = FALSE

        OR (
            task.due_at IS NOT NULL
            AND task.due_at < NOW()
            AND task.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
        )
      )

    ORDER BY
        priority_rank ASC,
        task.due_at ASC NULLS LAST,
        appointment.starts_at ASC NULLS LAST,
        task.created_at ASC

    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM clinic_context
    )
),

queue_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE task_status = 'open'
        )::INTEGER AS open_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE task_status = 'in_progress'
        )::INTEGER AS in_progress_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE is_overdue = TRUE
        )::INTEGER AS overdue_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE priority = 'urgent'
        )::INTEGER AS urgent_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE priority = 'high'
        )::INTEGER AS high_count

    FROM filtered_tasks
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM filtered_tasks
        )
            THEN 'handoff_queue_empty'

        ELSE 'handoff_queue_loaded'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM filtered_tasks
        )
            THEN 'تسکی مطابق فیلترهای انتخاب‌شده در صف وجود ندارد.'

        ELSE 'صف پیگیری منشی با موفقیت دریافت شد.'
    END AS message,

    request.clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT total_count
        FROM queue_summary
    ) AS total_count,

    (
        SELECT open_count
        FROM queue_summary
    ) AS open_count,

    (
        SELECT in_progress_count
        FROM queue_summary
    ) AS in_progress_count,

    (
        SELECT overdue_count
        FROM queue_summary
    ) AS overdue_count,

    (
        SELECT urgent_count
        FROM queue_summary
    ) AS urgent_count,

    (
        SELECT high_count
        FROM queue_summary
    ) AS high_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'handoff_task_id',
                        handoff_task_id,

                    'task_type',
                        task_type,

                    'priority',
                        priority,

                    'task_status',
                        task_status,

                    'is_overdue',
                        is_overdue,

                    'assigned_to',
                        assigned_to,

                    'reason',
                        reason,

                    'due_at',
                        due_at,

                    'attempt_count',
                        attempt_count,

                    'last_attempt_at',
                        last_attempt_at,

                    'last_contact_channel',
                        last_contact_channel,

                    'last_contact_outcome',
                        last_contact_outcome,

                    'patient_id',
                        patient_id,

                    'patient_name',
                        patient_name,

                    'mobile',
                        mobile,

                    'appointment_id',
                        appointment_id,

                    'doctor_name',
                        doctor_name,

                    'service_name',
                        service_name,

                    'appointment_date',
                        CASE
                            WHEN starts_at IS NULL
                                THEN NULL
                            ELSE TO_CHAR(
                                starts_at
                                AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                                'YYYY-MM-DD'
                            )
                        END,

                    'start_time',
                        CASE
                            WHEN starts_at IS NULL
                                THEN NULL
                            ELSE TO_CHAR(
                                starts_at
                                AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                                'HH24:MI'
                            )
                        END,

                    'appointment_status',
                        appointment_status,

                    'source_type',
                        source_type,

                    'source_record_id',
                        source_record_id,

                    'next_action',
                        CASE
                            WHEN task_status = 'open'
                                THEN 'claim_task'
                            WHEN task_status = 'in_progress'
                                THEN 'process_task'
                            ELSE 'view_task'
                        END
                )
                ORDER BY
                    priority_rank,
                    due_at ASC NULLS LAST,
                    starts_at ASC NULLS LAST,
                    created_at
            )
            FROM filtered_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS handoff_tasks

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## مشاهده صف منشی انسانی

ابتدا Workflow شماره 31 را یک‌بار اجرا کن.

فیلترهای اصلی:
- status_filter: active / open / in_progress / resolved / cancelled / all
- priority_filter: urgent / high / normal / low / all
- task_type_filter: نوع تسک یا all
- assigned_to: نام مسئول یا خالی
- overdue_only: فقط تسک‌های عقب‌افتاده

خروجی علاوه بر فهرست، خلاصه تعداد تسک‌های باز، درحال انجام، فوری و عقب‌افتاده را می‌دهد.
